name: Disentangled Conditional NeRF
definition: An architecture that achieves individual control over shape and appearance by isolating shape conditioning to explicit volumetric deformation of the positional encoding, preventing mutual intervention where shape changes affect color.
summary: Disentangled Conditional NeRF is a generative neural radiance field that achieves independent control over object shape and appearance by isolating shape conditioning to explicit volumetric deformation.
